draft.subject: One next step for Clearwater Dynamics
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

Thanks again for the question about the weekly summary email — as I mentioned, it isn't available yet, but it's on the roadmap and I've flagged your interest. Your ticket on that is closed, so just say the word if anything else comes up.

Since you've got a project going, the natural next step is putting real work inside it — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first step with you and your teammate.

Best,
Priya
